    "Main_Findings": [
      "Harmonization of Bachelor of Education Science curricula in the EAC is ongoing but faces challenges.",

      "Significant variations still exist in curriculum content and delivery across universities.",
      "The EAC Protocol on Education and Training provides a framework for harmonization, but implementation is uneven."
